posts.name: Musaab Khan
posts.cooked: I couldn’t attend quiz 1 as I was out of India. Is it possible for me to repeat quiz 1 at quiz 2?

posts.name: Diptanshu Suraj dube
posts.cooked:
no I don’t think so. And don’t worry cause the Eligibility to attend the end term exam:

Average of the best 5 out of the first 7 weekly assessments (objective and programming) scores >= 40/100
source: grading policy(System Commands course only)

posts.name: Ishan Shishodiya
posts.cooked:
image1864×1327 289 KB

There’s no quiz 2 for System Commands. Missing Quiz 1 won’t affect your ET eligibility, but your max score now is 75 (B grade).
